routeIdentity.finding: The receipt, field map, instructions, and rendered packet consistently identify the Vermont pardoned-conviction sealing route.

sourceIdentity.finding: All three source hashes and byte lengths were independently recomputed from the mounted corpus bytes and match the receipt.

componentSet.finding: Both fixtures contain the petition, stipulation/order, and fee-waiver application, and the participant filing instructions are present.

knownPrefills.finding: Byte-derived write reports prove 47 mapped writes across the six document/fixture combinations; the focused audit measured no missing or invisible required prefill.

requiredBeforeFiling.finding: Every one of the 112 declared required-before-filing disclosures is named in participant-instructions.md.

routeOptions.finding: The pardon route selects its dedicated complete form set; record-dependent sworn checkboxes remain participant elections rather than missing route-determined selections.

repeatingRows.finding: The independent focused audit found no partially completed repeating row.

protectedFields.finding: Cross-checking byte-derived actual writes against protected selection, signature, prosecutor, and court fields found no protected write.

artifacts.finding: Canonical and boundary PDF hashes and byte lengths were independently recomputed and match the artifact record.

pageOrder.finding: Both six-page fixtures follow the same recorded manifest order.

clippingAndOverlap.finding: All six byte-derived document reports measured zero non-whitespace glyphs outside write boxes, and the focused audit measured no visual defect.

filingDestination.finding: Instructions direct the participant to the Vermont Superior Court unit for the county where the case was decided.

evidence.destination: Superior Court unit (county) where the case was decided

feeAndWaiver.finding: Instructions explain when to use the included fee-waiver application but never state the filing fee (including whether an amount must be confirmed with the court).

service.finding: Instructions require the State's Attorney's agreement and signature for the stipulation route but do not state who must be served or how service must be made.

selfHelpStop.finding: Instructions expressly say the packet is not legal advice, is not filed for the participant, and does not decide whether sealing will be granted.
